shadows.name: small
shadows.purpose: Ambient lift on chips and small interactive elements

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Primary action button — forest green with white text. Used for CTAs, form submissions, and key interactions.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #2D6A4F; color: #FFFFFF; padding: 12px 16px; border-radius: 8px; font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 600; line-height: 20px; border: none; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.15s ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #1B4332; } .ds-btn-primary:active { background: #1B4332; transform: scale(0.98); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #2D6A4F; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Secondary action button — mint wash with green text. Used for less critical actions.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { background: #D1FAE5; color: #2D6A4F; padding: 12px 16px; border-radius: 8px; font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 600; line-height: 20px; border: none; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.15s ease; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: #A8E6C3; } .ds-btn-secondary:active { background: #A8E6C3; transform: scale(0.98); }

components.name: Elevated Card
components.description: Default card container — white background with subtle shadow. Used for product items, consultation entries, and interactive content.

components.name: Chip
components.description: Filter/selection pill — outlined by default, filled when selected. Used across consultation filters, shop categories, and health record tags.
components.css: .ds-chip { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; padding: 8px 12px; border-radius: 999px; border: 1px solid #E5E7EB; background: transparent; color: #1A1A1A; font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; cursor: pointer; transition: all 0.15s ease; } .ds-chip:hover { border-color: #2D6A4F; } .ds-chip-selected { background: #2D6A4F; color: #FFFFFF; border-color: #2D6A4F; }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: Standard text input — white background with neutral border, green focus state.
components.css: .ds-input-wrapper { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 4px; } .ds-input-label { font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; color: #1A1A1A; } .ds-input { background: #FFFFFF; border: 1px solid #E5E7EB; border-radius: 8px; padding: 12px; font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; color: #1A1A1A; outline: none; transition: border-color 0.15s ease; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: #9CA3AF; } .ds-input:focus { border-color: #2D6A4F; } .ds-input-error { border-color: #DC2626; }

components.name: Tab Bar Item
components.description: Bottom navigation tab — icon + label, green when active, fog-colored when inactive.
components.html: Home
components.css: .ds-tab { display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; gap: 4px; padding: 8px 0; cursor: pointer; } .ds-tab-icon { width: 24px; height: 24px; color: #9CA3AF; transition: color 0.15s ease; } .ds-tab-label { font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, sans-serif; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 400; color: #9CA3AF; } .ds-tab-active .ds-tab-icon { color: #2D6A4F; } .ds-tab-active .ds-tab-label { color: #2D6A4F; font-weight: 600; }

narrative.overview: The Amrutam design system channels the quiet authority of a well-curated apothecary — every remedy has its place, every element earns its presence. The palette is rooted in deep forest greens that evoke Ayurvedic tradition without drifting into literal leaf imagery. Surfaces are clean but never sterile; the warm-gray backgrounds and generous spacing create breathing room that feels intentional, not empty. This system explicitly rejects the clinical coldness of generic telemedicine apps and the trendy DTC wellness aesthetic of beige-and-blur minimalism.
keyCharacteristics: Deep muted green as the singular brand anchor — used with restraint, never wallpaper
Tonal layering over shadow-heavy elevation — depth through color shifts, not drop shadows
System typography at comfortable sizes — legible, unhurried, never shouting
Generous whitespace that lets content breathe — the apothecary shelf, not the cluttered drawer
Status colors tied to the green family for cohesion — even errors feel grounded, not alarming

rules.name: The One Green Rule
rules.body: The primary green (#2D6A4F) is the only brand color. It appears on ≤15% of any given screen. Its restraint is the point.

rules.name: The Status Family Rule
rules.body: All status colors harmonize with the green anchor. Error red is the single exception — it must break the harmony to signal danger.

rules.name: The Comfortable Size Rule
rules.body: Body text never drops below 14px. This is a wellness app used during personal health moments — squinting undermines the sense of care.

rules.name: The Weight Discipline Rule
rules.body: Only three weights: 400 (body), 600 (emphasis), 700 (headings). The system typeface handles personality through size and spacing, not weight.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Surfaces are flat at rest. Shadows appear only on elevated containers and interactive press states. Depth belongs to containers, not content.

dos: Do use the primary green (#2D6A4F) as the singular brand anchor
Do keep body text at 14px or above
Do use tonal layering to convey depth instead of heavy shadows
Do maintain generous whitespace — the apothecary shelf is organized, not crowded
Do use the system typeface at the defined sizes and weights
Do let status colors harmonize with the green family
Do use pill-shaped chips for filters and selection
donts: Don't use generic telemedicine aesthetics — no clinical blue-white palettes, no insurance-form layouts
Don't add border-left or border-right greater than 1px as a colored accent
Don't use background-clip: text with gradients
Don't over-round cards — cards top out at 12px radius
Don't pair a 1px border with a wide box-shadow (≥16px blur) on the same element
Don't put shadows on text, icons, or inline elements
Don't add tiny uppercase tracked eyebrows above every section
